summary: FAIL. The round-11 repairs work as designed, and I closed F-DG0-226, 227 and 228 as CLOSED_VERIFIED. Every required command passes, as does prefreeze in a fresh clone. The A24/A25 negatives pass 94/94 once the fixtures carry the settings.json that D-025 now requires. Register integrity, agent-load evidence and feasibility pass. The live guard and OS sandbox refused all 17 protected writes from my own session. One new Medium finding blocks: F-DG0-229. An analyst or implementer shell can plant gitignored bytecode that the orchestrator's unsandboxed prefreeze executes, a traceless way around the D-025 shell sandbox. There are also three Low findings, which I'd accept as observations: F-DG0-230 (validator deny-list root check), F-DG0-231 (docs drift, e.g. /tmp is read-only in the sandbox), F-DG0-232 (the register doesn't reflect D-025). One check is BLOCKED because the sandbox has no network: the round-11 live CLI experiment couldn't be repeated, and the other layers cover it.
